name: VA HOME ADMIN 2.0 POLISH
changes: Adds a mobile/PWA quick action for New Order without changing the storefront navigation
Turns the admin connectivity badge into a real synchronized / syncing / offline / error state with a silent 60-second refresh
Separates paid revenue from active-order value and money still awaiting payment
Sorts Needs Attention by operational priority and shows relative age
Adds keyboard-first global search, match highlighting and premium confirmation dialogs
Expands manual orders with customer lookup, Discovery Set, reed add-ons and promo codes while preserving server validation
Adds an isolated VA HOME audit trail for orders, reviews, promo codes and private releases
notes: Storefront product, cart, checkout, Monobank and public search logic remain on the v16.3.0 functional baseline aside from release-version cache markers.
The VA HOME audit migration is already applied in production and is isolated from all vacleaner_* objects.
No Edge Function is redeployed for this polish release; the live queue-based admin-order-update flow remains untouched.
Manual orders still go through the existing validated create-order pipeline.
